常用位置: 打开压缩包后，其所在目录会自动显示在这里。
Favorite locations: Folders of archives you open will appear here automatically.

常用位置: 这个文件夹里没有可显示的内容。
Favorite locations: This folder has no visible items.

常用位置: 目标磁盘不区分大小写，“{first}”与“{second}”会重名。已在写入前停止；请改用区分大小写的磁盘，以完整保留两个文件。
Favorite locations: The destination treats '{first}' and '{second}' as the same name. Extraction stopped before writing. Use a case-sensitive volume to preserve both files.

常用位置: 目标位置已有同名文件。请选择新的保存位置或空文件夹；解压时也可在设置中调整“文件已存在时”的处理方式。
Favorite locations: The destination already contains a file with the same name. Choose a new output path or an empty folder, or change the extraction conflict setting.

常用位置: 收藏常用文件夹，打开后可继续浏览文件。
Favorite locations: Save folders here for quick access.

常用位置: 还没有保存密码。列表只显示名称，不显示明文。
Favorite locations: No passwords saved. This list only shows labels, never secrets.

常用位置: 系统钥匙串不可用，密码仅在本次运行中保留。
Favorite locations: System keychain unavailable. Passwords are kept for this session only.

常用位置: 标签可用压缩包文件名；启用设置中的“记住密码”后会自动使用对应密码。
Favorite locations: Use the archive file name as its label. Enable Remember passwords in Settings to use it automatically.

常用位置: 名称 / 压缩包文件名
请填写名称和密码；名称应为文件名或短名称，不含路径，且不能是 __labels__。
Favorite locations: Enter a short label and password. Paths and the reserved label __labels__ are not allowed.

常用位置: 此名称已存在，请修改已有条目或使用其他名称。
Favorite locations: This label exists. Edit that entry or choose another name.

常用位置: 无法访问系统钥匙串，请解锁钥匙串后重试。
Favorite locations: Cannot access the keychain. Unlock it and try again.

常用位置: 删除这个已保存的密码？
此操作只删除密码本条目，不修改压缩包。请确认仍记得这个密码。
Favorite locations: This only removes the saved password. Make sure you still know it.

常用位置: 新包密码（留空表示不加密）
流式转换并另存新包。请确认目标加密设置，源包保持不变。
Favorite locations: Stream to a new archive. Check output encryption before continuing. The source is preserved.

常用位置: 抢救可读文件并另存；损坏内容可能无法恢复。完成后查看恢复报告。
Favorite locations: Recover readable files into a new archive. Damaged data may be lost. Review the recovery report afterwards.

常用位置: 新包不加密；如需保护内容，请选 ZIP / 7z 并设置新密码。
Favorite locations: The output is unencrypted. Choose ZIP / 7z and set a password to protect it.

常用位置: 已恢复 {files} 项 · 已跳过 {skipped} 项
未发现需要跳过的条目。恢复结果已通过完整性校验。
Favorite locations: No entries were skipped. The recovered archive passed integrity verification.
Only the first 1000 details are shown.

常用位置: ZIP 中央目录不可读，已通过本地文件头恢复；权限和链接类型等属性可能丢失，无法识别的链接会按普通文件保存。
Favorite locations: The ZIP directory is unreadable. Local headers were used; permissions and link types may be lost, and unidentified links become regular files.

常用位置: 中央目录缺失，无法安全恢复加密、ZIP64、数据描述符或截断条目。
Favorite locations: Cannot safely recover encrypted, ZIP64, descriptor or truncated entries without the directory.

常用位置: 当前写入格式接口无法保留符号链接，已跳过。
Favorite locations: Symbolic links cannot currently be preserved and were skipped.

常用位置: 条目路径不安全，已跳过；请检查源压缩包。
Favorite locations: Unsafe entry path; skipped. Check the source archive.

常用位置: 数据完整性校验失败，已跳过；请尝试其他源文件副本。
Favorite locations: Integrity verification failed; skipped. Try another copy of the source.

常用位置: 数据已截断，无法完整恢复，已跳过。
Favorite locations: Data is truncated and cannot be fully recovered; skipped.

常用位置: 所属固实块已损坏，无法解码此条目。
Favorite locations: The solid block is damaged; this entry cannot be decoded.

常用位置: 文件名重复或与文件夹冲突，已跳过。
Favorite locations: Duplicate file name or folder conflict; skipped.

常用位置: 无法保存常用位置，请检查设置文件夹权限后重试。
Favorite locations: Cannot save favorites. Check permissions for the settings folder.

常用位置: 无法保存设置，请检查设置文件夹权限后重试。
Favorite locations: Cannot save settings. Check permissions for the settings folder.

常用位置: 无法打开该位置，请确认文件夹仍存在且有访问权限。
Favorite locations: Cannot open this location. Check that the folder exists and is accessible.

常用位置: 转换完成，新包已通过完整性校验。
Favorite locations: Conversion complete. The new archive passed integrity verification.

常用位置: 恢复完成，请查看恢复报告确认是否有跳过项。
Favorite locations: Recovery complete. Review the report for skipped entries.

常用位置: 你选择的文件不是一个压缩包。
Favorite locations: The file you chose is not an archive.

常用位置: 暂不支持该类型文件的压缩、解压和管理。
Favorite locations: This file type is not supported for compressing, extracting or managing yet.

常用位置: 这个压缩包已损坏，无法打开。
Favorite locations: This archive is damaged and cannot be opened.

常用位置: 找不到这个文件，它可能已被移动或删除。
Favorite locations: The file was not found. It may have been moved or deleted.

常用位置: 没有权限读取这个文件，请检查文件权限。
Favorite locations: You do not have permission to read this file. Check its permissions.

常用位置: 这个压缩包触发了安全限制，已停止打开。
Favorite locations: This archive hit a safety limit, so opening was stopped.

常用位置: 无法读取这个文件，请确认它没有被占用后重试。
Favorite locations: The file could not be read. Make sure it is not in use and try again.

常用位置: 还没有任务记录。压缩、解压、测试等任务完成后会出现在这里。
Favorite locations: No task history yet. Finished compress, extract and test tasks show up here.

常用位置: 保留最近 200 条，只记录文件名和结果。
Favorite locations: The latest 200 are kept, with file names and results only.

常用位置: 分卷大小（MiB，留空则不分卷）
Favorite locations: Volume size (MiB; empty means no split)

常用位置: 分卷大小请输入正整数 MiB。
Favorite locations: Enter a positive whole number of MiB for the volume size.

字典大小请输入 1 到 64 MiB。
Favorite locations: Enter a dictionary size from 1 to 64 MiB.

Favorite locations: Solid block size (MiB; empty means whole archive, 0 disables solid mode)

常用位置: 固实块大小请输入 0 或正整数 MiB。
Favorite locations: Enter 0 or a positive whole number of MiB.

Favorite locations: This task reached a resource or safety limit. Review its settings and try again.

常用位置: 解压成功后在文件管理器中显示结果目录。
Favorite locations: After extraction, reveal the output directory in the file manager.

常用位置: 任务完成或失败时发送简短通知，不包含文件名或路径。
Favorite locations: Send a short notification when a task finishes or fails; it contains no file names or paths.
